answers.question: How many days before I bought the iPhone 13 Pro did I attend the Holiday Market?
answers.gold: 7 days. 8 days (including the last day) is also acceptable.
answers.answer:
You attended the Holiday Market a week before Black Friday, which was on November 25, 2022. Therefore, the Holiday Market was on November 18, 2022. You bought the iPhone 13 Pro on Black Friday, November 25, 2022. 

Calculating the days between these two dates: 
November 25, 2022 - November 18, 2022 = 7 days.

So, you attended the Holiday Market 7 days before you bought the iPhone 13 Pro.
answers.label: CORRECT
